coma-star-cluster.d: A loose, prominent open cluster located high above the galactic plane in Coma Berenices.

vela-pulsar.d: Rapidly rotating neutron star (period: 89 ms) powering the central filaments of the Vela SNR.

crab-pulsar.d: Young central neutron star (period: 33 ms) formed in the 1054 CE supernova at the heart of the Crab Nebula.
